low.label: Half-year to annual run-rate factor
low.rationale: The two 2026 half-years are of comparable seasonality; Q1 2026 diluted EPS $1.41 and Q2 2026 $1.45 differ by 3%, so doubling the half is a fair annualisation.

low.label: Fintech owner-earnings growth, years 1 to 7
low.rationale: Adjusted fintech fee revenue compounded 14.4% a year from $82.3m in 2021 to $141.3m in 2025 and GDV compounded 14.3% over the same span, with positive operating leverage in every year (expense per $1,000 of GDV fell from $0.67 to $0.45). The base case fades that to 9% because the $10bn asset cap limits deposit-funded spread growth. The low case assumes partner attrition and interchange compression; the high case assumes Apex 2030 embedded finance delivers.

low.label: Cost of equity
low.rationale: Small-cap bank cost of equity with a premium for fintech partner concentration and sponsor-bank regulatory risk.

low.label: Terminal multiple on year-7 owner earnings
low.rationale: A fee-based payments franchise supports a higher exit multiple than a balance sheet lender. TBBK trades at 13.6x trailing earnings today; the base case assumes the fee mix earns a modest premium to that, the low case a discount to bank-like economics.

method_fit.label: High-return compounder
applicability_tests: Owner earnings can be separated from stock compensation, working capital, and maintenance capital.
Incremental returns on retained capital are observable and durable.
The competitive advantage explains pricing, retention, share, or cost outcomes.
Terminal value is supported by a reinvestment runway rather than an unexplained multiple.
failure_modes: growth projected without its capital cost
terminal value unsupported by a durable mechanism

validation_cohort.purpose: Test depletion, commodity exposure, finite reserves, and royalty-unit reconciliation.
Test tangible capital, credit losses, funding, regulation, and excess-capital realization.
Test owner earnings, capital-light reinvestment, cyclicality, and buyback value creation.
Test normalized margins, industry supply response, replacement cost, and reinvestment timing.
Test product concentration, pipeline probabilities, patent cliffs, and catalyst timing.

method_fit.rule: Use one primary method and no more than two corroborating methods; irrelevant methods and personas remain silent.

outcomes.weighting_rule: Do not change a persona's relevance within a power zone until at least 20 attributable, dividend-aware outcomes exist there; never reweight automatically.

top_claims.claim: Revenue moved -90.5% versus the prior period (103,546.0 to 9,822.0).
Cash moved -80.2% versus the prior period (570,123.0 to 112,649.0).

At about $63.89 per share, our base case implies 16.73% per year over seven years on normalized owner earnings of $4.92 per share, meeting the ~15% threshold but below the >20% accumulate bar.
